centri.frammento: An additional fee may apply if you go through visa service centres, which collect applications on behalf of consulates in some cases.

tempi.frammento: The normal processing time for a visa application is 15 days. This period may be extended to up to 45 days

residenza.frammento: you must apply for a Schengen visa at the consulate with territorial responsibility for the country where you are legally resident

assicurazione.frammento: Medical insurance covering emergency medical care, hospitalisation and repatriation (including in the event of death).

copertura.frammento: The minimum coverage shall be EUR 30 000.

assicurazione_residenza.frammento: Applicants shall, in principle, take out insurance in their country of residence.

assicurazione_mev.frammento: shall prove that they are in possession of adequate and valid travel medical insurance covering the period of their first intended visit

art6.frammento: An application shall be examined and decided on by the consulate of the competent Member State in whose jurisdiction the applicant legally resides.

art6_2.frammento: shall examine and decide on an application lodged by a third-country national legally present but not residing in its jurisdiction, if the applicant has provided justification for lodging the application at that consulate

art21_5.frammento: on the basis of the reference amounts set by the Member States in accordance with Article 34(1)(c) of the Schengen Borders Code. Proof of sponsorship and/or private accommodation may also constitute evidence of sufficient means of subsistence.

fornitori.frammento: To apply for a Schengen visa in the United Kingdom go to the VFS Global application centre in Birmingham, Edinburgh, London or Manchester.
fornitori.testo: The Dutch government's page says to apply at the VFS Global application centre in Birmingham, Edinburgh, London or Manchester.

fornitori.frammento: operated by our service provider, TLScontact, serve visa applicants residing in England (with exceptions, see below), Northern Ireland and Wales
fornitori.testo: The German missions' page says the visa application centres in London and Manchester (for England, with exceptions, Northern Ireland and Wales) and Edinburgh (for Scotland) are operated by TLScontact.

fornitori.frammento: Appointments are exclusively managed through our service partner, VFS Global.
fornitori.testo: The Italian Consulate General in London says appointments are managed only through its service partner, VFS Global, which charges an extra service fee.

fornitori.frammento: For all general visa enquiries (application process, processing times, appointments, documentation required) please contact TLScontact
fornitori.testo: The Belgian embassy's page sends questions about the application process, appointments and documents to TLScontact.

fornitori.frammento: visa application center in London, operated by VFS Global
fornitori.testo: The Portuguese Consulate General in London says its visa application centre in London is operated by VFS Global.

fornitori.frammento: To apply for a Schengen visa in the United Arab Emirates go to the VFS Global application centre in Abu Dhabi or Dubai.
fornitori.testo: The Dutch government's page says to apply at the VFS Global application centre in Abu Dhabi or Dubai.

fornitori.frammento: The Consulate works exclusively with the external service provider VFS Global. Visa applications can be submitted by appointment only at the VFS Global Germany Visa Application Centres in Abu Dhabi or Dubai.
fornitori.testo: The German Consulate General in Dubai works only with VFS Global: applications by appointment at the VFS Global centres in Abu Dhabi or Dubai.

fornitori.frammento: may apply to BLS International. Residents of the Emirate of Dubai and Northern Emirates are instead advised to contact the Dubai Consulate General which operates through the VFS Global Dubai office
fornitori.testo: The Italian embassy in Abu Dhabi takes applications from holders of an Abu Dhabi residence visa through BLS International; residents of Dubai and the Northern Emirates go to the Consulate General in Dubai, which works through VFS Global.
